name: Dewebkiller Store Style Customizer for WooCommerce
author: Niresh Shrestha

sections.description:
Dewebkiller Store Style Customizer for WooCommerce allows you to easily customize key design elements like:

  • Change primary color (default violet)
  • Adjust button border radius
  • Style quantity buttons
  • Set global font family
  • Choose from built-in preset themes
  • Live preview with WordPress Customizer

Do you have features that you want to add? **
**Request a feature

All changes are reflected live on your WooCommerce frontend without touching code.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Style Switcher to start customizing
sections.faq:
How do I access the settings?

Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Style Switcher tab.

Does this work with any theme?

Yes, it works with most themes that use standard WooCommerce templates.

Can I reset back to defaults?

Yes, by deleting the saved values or re-setting manually.
